title: Hands of Torment
description: A surreal scene set on a colorful Italian street with stairs leading to the Colosseum in the background. In the foreground, a screaming woman is being grabbed and pulled at the face and head by multiple disembodied hands emerging from a glowing yellow light.
prompt: A surreal scene of a terrified screaming woman in the foreground being violently grabbed by numerous disembodied hands pulling at her face and hair. The setting is a narrow colorful Italian alley with stairs leading up to the ancient Colosseum under a bright sky. Clothes hang on lines between buildings, flower pots with pink flowers line the steps, dramatic golden light rays pierce the scene creating a nightmarish atmosphere.
